versions.changelog:
- Security update: All CLI API calls now send the PIN in the request body via POST, instead of as a URL query parameter.
- Clarified SKILL.md to reflect the new PIN handling method and improved wording for security notes.
- Cleaned up documentation for accuracy; no changes to commands or user flow.
- Removed the unused skill-card.md file.

**Summary:** Command interface streamlined and all actions now go through the bundled CLI wrapper for improved reliability and security.

- All API calls now performed via the included `bokatvattid.py` CLI, not direct HTTP requests.
- Expanded and clarified supported commands: buildings search, login, room list, show/book/cancel slots, show bookings.
- More detailed handling for credentials (PIN, building ID, apartment number) with prioritized secure resolution (config/env).
- Only v1-mode buildings supported; user now clearly prompted to confirm before any booking/cancellation.
- Security notes and interactive confirmation improved; `--yes` flag required for non-interactive booking/cancelling.
- Updated and removed obsolete documentation (skill-card.md removed; API references updated).
First release: generic laundry/guest-apartment booking CLI for bokatvattid.se (any v1-mode building). Rooms/buildings resolved dynamically, no hardcoded ids. Live-tested login, slots, book, cancel.
